dcterms:description: The Ukbench dataset contains 10,200 images composed of 2,550 groups. Each image is taken as a query in turn, and three groundtruth images with extensive variations are provided.
dcterms:title: Ukbench

dcterms:description: The Holidays dataset is released with 1,491 personal holiday pictures. There are 500 queries in total. Mean Average Precision (mAP) is used to evaluate search accuracy.
dcterms:title: Holidays

dcterms:description: The Flickr343Places dataset contains images crawled using the names of 343 countries and regions across the world, varying from scenes to objects.
dcterms:title: Flickr343Places

dcterms:description: The VIPeR dataset is composed of 632 persons, each having two images captured from two cameras, undergoing extensive variances in viewpoint, pose, illumination, etc.
dcterms:title: VIPeR
